stories.who: Schneider Electric, a French electrical equipment group, and P T C, an American maker of the software factories use to design and run their products
stories.what: Schneider agreed to buy P T C for about twenty three billion dollars in cash; regulators still have to approve the deal
stories.why_for_people: Factories that rely on that software would depend on one giant group for it
stories.script: In business. French group Schneider Electric agreed to buy factory software maker P T C. Factories that rely on that software would depend on one giant group.

stories.who: A hacking group that security researchers at Proofpoint link to the Chinese government
stories.what: Posed as an Anthropic employee in emails to A I policy experts, then sent them files with hidden malware to get into their cloud accounts
stories.why_for_people: The people who help shape A I rules are being spied on through hidden malware; the China link is the researchers' judgement
stories.script: In security. Hackers linked to China posed as an-thropic staff and emailed A I policy experts. Their files hid malware to spy on those who help shape A I rules.

stories.who: T S M C, the world's largest maker of chips for other companies, based in Taiwan
stories.what: Is reported to be planning another price rise of three to six percent on its most advanced chip wafers for early next year, because demand is bigger than supply; T S M C has not confirmed it
stories.why_for_people: A I products, chips and services would get more expensive for the people who buy them; the report is unconfirmed
stories.script: From Taiwan. The biggest chip maker T S M C is reportedly planning to raise its prices next year. That would make A I products, chips and services more expensive.

stories.who: Germany, whose leader Friedrich Merz announced it in Kyiv, and Quantum Systems, a German drone start-up that will build the drones in Ukraine
stories.what: Germany will pay for tens of thousands of small drones, built in Ukraine, that hunt and shoot down enemy drones; the exact number and dates are not given
stories.why_for_people: People in Ukraine's cities should get more protection from Russian drones this winter; the drones are built in Ukraine
stories.script: In robotics. Germany will pay for tens of thousands of drones that hunt down enemy drones. They are built in Ukraine to shield its cities from Russian drones this winter.
stories.screen: a small glowing four-rotor drone with a simple shield shape beneath it, text-free symbol

stories.who: Reflection, an American A I start-up backed by the chip maker Nvidia
stories.what: Reportedly plans to release a free A I model that anyone can download and run; it is said to trail the best American systems but match the best Chinese free models; nothing is released yet
stories.why_for_people: Firms that want a free A I they run themselves would get a U S choice instead of only Chinese free models; nothing is released yet
stories.script: In new models. Start-up Reflection reportedly plans a free A I model anyone can run. Firms would get a U S choice instead of only Chinese free models.

stories.who: Researchers at Stanford University in California
stories.what: Set thousands of A I helpers to read records of old drug trials; the helpers found that drugs aimed at genes active in only a few body cells did better in trials
stories.why_for_people: Their finding may help drug makers pick safer drugs before testing them on people, but no lab has tested it yet
stories.script: In health. Stanford researchers had thousands of A I helpers read the records of old drug trials. Their finding may help pick safer drugs, but no lab has tested it yet.

stories.who: McDonald's, the fast food chain, and the owners of its American restaurants
stories.what: Reporters found that McDonald's uses A I to suggest a price for each item at each restaurant; the chain calls it optional, some owners say they feel pushed to follow
stories.why_for_people: Diners may pay more for the same burger than at a store nearby; McDonald's calls the tool optional
stories.script: In daily life. McDonald's reportedly uses A I to suggest prices at its restaurants. McDonald's calls it optional, but some owners feel pushed and diners may pay more.

fun.what: Promised never to use A I, and tens of thousands of people watched the posts
fun.why_for_people: A small sign that refusing A I can be a selling point, for small shops and the people who buy from them
fun.script: In lighter news. A Florida pizza shop promised never to use A I, and tens of thousands watched. It is a small sign that refusing A I can be a selling point.

teaser.who: I B M, the American computer company; and Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine, as told by one military analyst
teaser.what: I B M says its quantum computer did one test in seconds that a supercomputer would need many years for; one analyst says twelve A I-controlled guns now guard Kyiv from Russian drones
teaser.why_for_people: A sign of how fast new computers may get, on one test only; and more protection for people in Kyiv, with no official confirmation
teaser.script: Also in the full report. I B M says a quantum test took seconds where a supercomputer needs years. And an analyst says twelve A I guns now guard Kyiv from Russian drones.

bp.who: A I company shares and the American bond market
bp.what: Hope in A I is holding tech shares up while the cost of borrowing in the U S is at its highest in about twenty four years
bp.why_for_people: If U S borrowing costs stay this high the A I share rally could fade, which touches anyone with savings in those shares
bp.script: And for the bigger picture: A I hope keeps tech shares up while U S borrowing costs hit a twenty-four-year high. Watch those costs, because a fading A I rally could hit savings in those shares.
